answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 43074 Country: India Title: Aqeeqah Question: At the occasion of shadi (nikah) ceremony the animal used like goat, buffalo for meat can be possible for aqiqah? Answer ID: 43074 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 121/112/B=1434) If it is the feast of sunnat walimah then it is not necessary separate goat for walimah. One goat shall suffice for both. If you are slaughtering buffalo etc then you can fix one or two shares for aqiqah and rest of the shares for walimah, then it is also correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
